summary: A look at al-Qaeda leader Osama bin Laden's life and at the media files the CIA recovered from his Abbottabad, Pakistan hideout, where he lived from 2006 until US forces killed him in 2011.

evidence.note: brief biography starts with his 1957 birth and family
move to Afghanistan, training camps, cave hideout around 9/11
moves into the Abbottabad compound in 2006; courier-based internet access
theory that al-Qaeda hid operational messages in porn files; Berlin arrest example
CIA's November 2017 release of about 470,000 files from the raid
catalogue of films, documentaries, anime and cartoons on the drives
Christian conspiracy tract about the Illuminati card game found in his files

notes: Mostly a tour of the 2017 CIA release of the Abbottabad files rather than a full biography. main_span is set to the Abbottabad years (2006-2011) that the files document, not his al-Qaeda career. The 2015 FOIA fight and the 2017 release are treated as reaches_present rather than extending covered_span.
